mostWorthwhile.text: Adding position feedback was most worthwhile because it showed how information from the muscles helps adjust a movement alongside sight.

leastWorthwhile.text: Making the nerve-linked arm felt somewhat repetitive because the preceding result had already identified the need for an outgoing route, and it was the only offered combination.

surprise.text: I was interested that the spinal cord participates in local responses rather than simply carrying signals.

arbitrary.text: No action felt arbitrary; each had a stated role in connecting sight, control or feedback to movement.

continue.text: I would continue to see how the guided arm gains the supplies it needs, although several choices here were predictable once only one combination remained.
